C715277.failed_steps: Blocked before step 1: the set-up cannot be made — ShopView refuses a second customer whose name differs only in capitals
observed: Creating customer "zzcaps haulage" next to "ZZCAPS Haulage" is refused: "Company with provided name already exists."
The New Customer window on screen shows the red message "Company with provided name already exists." and creates nothing.

Renaming another customer to "zzcaps haulage" on its Edit Customer window is refused the same way (the name stays). A rename to a name that clashes with nothing saves normally, so the refusal is real.
So two customers whose names differ only in capitals cannot exist on this site, and the order of such a pair cannot be checked.
